notes: I changed the small-|x| region: E14 shows +x and -x give different values at the same |x|, so the residual is noise, not a deterministic even function. The best predictable value is the mean, which appears slightly above 16.8*|x| (small positive bias ~0.5) for |x|<1, while ordinary-range predictions stay at 16.8*|x|.
